#!/bin/bash
# Phase 1A spike stub worker -- detached heartbeat emitter (no real QPB work).
HB='{HEARTBEAT_PATH}'
TID='{TASK_ID}'
RD='{RUN_DIR}'
ts() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }
hb() { printf '{"ts": "%s", "task_id": "%s", "schema_version": "1", "phase": "stub", "step": "%s", "status": "%s"%s}\n' "$(ts)" "$TID" "$1" "$2" "$3" >> "$HB"; }

echo "stub completed at $(ts)" > "$RD/result.txt"
hb done COMPLETED ", \"result_file\": \"$RD/result.txt\", \"summary\": \"stub run completed\""
----END stub_worker.sh----
